tm.「……くそぉ 遺跡に着いたら\n さっさと 壁画を見て そのチカラで\n 出世の: "Damn, once I get to the ruins, I'll see the mural quickly and climb the ladder of success with its power.
tm.「この高台から見える 絶景を前にすると\n 小さなことで ウジウジしていたのが\: "Before this scenery from the heights, my fretting over small things seems silly...
tm.「壁画の件は 残念だったけど\n この村に来て よかったよ。: "The mural affair was a shame, but I'm glad I came to this village.
tm.「いやあ～ 外の空気はうまいな！\n 長い間 牢屋の中に閉じ込められてたから\n: "Ahh, the outside air is delicious! After being locked in a cell so long, even small things move me.
tm.「一時は どうなっちゃうかと思ったけど……\n 愛する彼女と外に出られて\n 今: "For a while I didn't know what would happen... but being out with my beloved, I feel great now! Thanks!
tm.「こうして 俺と彼女が巡り会えたのも\n 世助けパレードが 救ってくれたからだよ: "My girlfriend and I meeting again is thanks to the World-Saving Parade rescuing us. I wanted to thank them before they left.
tm.「彼らは 格好こそ不思議だったけれど\n 面白くて 優しくて たくましい人たちだ: "Their outfits were strange, but they were fun, kind, strong people. I'd like to meet them again someday.
tm.「このコが 俺のダンスを よかったと言うんだ。\n 今まで 踊ったことがなかった: "This girl says my dance was good. I'd never danced before... Maybe I have talent for dancing!
tm.「幸せを呼ぶ 壁画のウワサを聞いて\n この村に 旅行に来たのだけど\n こんな: "I heard rumors of the mural that brings happiness and came here. Do these souvenirs bring blessings too?
tm.「ラッキーアイテムを いっぱい買って\n これで 私もモテモテに……。\n うふ: "I'll buy lots of lucky items, and then I'll be popular... Hee hee...
tm.「幸せを呼ぶ 壁画のウワサを聞いて\n この村に 旅行に来たのに……。\n あん: "I came on a trip after hearing the mural brings happiness... and got caught up in such an incident.
tm.「……ふふ でも あなたという\n ステキな男性と会えたのは 幸運だったわ。\n: "...Hee hee, but meeting a lovely man like you was lucky. Thank you, {var:1}♪
tm.「パレードの人たちが あの牢屋から村まで\n 捕まっていた私たちを 送り届けてく: "The parade folks escorted us captives from that cell back to the village.
tm.「途中で 何度か魔物に襲われたんだけど\n シルビアって方が たちまち撃退してく: "A few times monsters attacked on the way, but Sylvando beat them right away! So cool!
